title: California 300
description: CA300-focused desert race park (16384 m). 2024 California 300 Race Ready GPX (~74 mi) at ~0.97x geo scale, with DecalRoad course + pit row. MUST import heightmap via import/ca300_gpx_scale.preset.json (squareSize=4, maxHeight=900, pos -8192,-8192).
features: CA300 course, pit row, danger markers, open desert freeroam
roads: Packed desert race corridor with dirt berms; open freeroam desert around the course
biome: Arid desert mesa / wash country (Lucerne-area inspired)

spawnPoints.description: Pit row / staging. Default CA300 start.
On the CA300 race line near start/finish.
